front.title: Verdict Records: Results on Claims that Cite Receipts as Evidence

abstract.t: This document defines a verdict record: a statement, bound to its issuer, of a result reached on a claim, together with the evidence the result relies on and the rule by which the result can be re- derived. Evidence is cited by digest and can be a receipt or record in any format, such as a SCITT Receipt or an Agent Action Capsule. The document defines how a checker checks a verdict record and what such a check does and does not show. It defines no receipt format and changes none.
